author: Hong Tran
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Chad & Brian were amazing! They were very quick, friendly, and professional. They did an excellent job cleaning our grease trap and made the whole process easy and hassle-free. I’m very happy with their service and would highly recommend Chad & Brian to anyone looking for grease trap cleaning!

author: Danielle Parris
text:
Chad and Kelly were incredibly helpful throughout the entire process. They responded to my call right away, asked all the right questions, and arrived at my client’s restaurant within just two hours late at night for an emergency septic tank pump-out.

They made a very stressful situation much easier to manage with their professionalism and quick response. I also really appreciated that they provided photos and videos of the completed work since I’m not local to the restaurant. Excellent service all around, highly recommend!!

author: Demetris Mallard
text: We scheduled a service to clean our grease trap on 06/03/2026. Chad and Dee came out. They were very knowledgeable, professional and efficient. They called prior to the service appointment. They were on time and we did not have to stop our business in order to receive the service. Great work!!!

author: bX-a Official
text: Here from Roma’s Italian Resturant in Kaufman, these guys are no joke and about the bussines, very professional and glad we use them for the grease trap, highly recommended!

author: Kevin Lefere
text: I would give this company six stars if that were an option! Call me old-fashioned, but the fact that the team showed up early to our first appointment and introduced themselves speaks volumes about their professionalism. I am very satisfied and happy to see businesses like this thriving.
